title: Plymouth, MN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Plymouth is a city in MN with a population of 79,000. Affluent Twin Cities suburb with top schools, Medicine Lake, and corporate parks. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
